versions.changelog:
Initial release of Pattern Lock Tutor.

- Command-line trainer for learning or changing motor sequences (pattern locks, PINs, combos, riffs) with error tracking and spaced repetition.
- Supports training from all sequence transpositions, alternating old/new patterns to combat interference, and enforcing accuracy before speed.
- Implements expanding recall intervals and per-session error logs.
- Provides session protocol to guide effective, short practice blocks and measures readiness with transparent criteria.
- All features terminal-based, with simple local JSON storage, no dependencies.
